Key: frames = trust/deployment zones; box = runtime actor/process; cylinder = stored state. Arrows: caller → recipient, response included;
dashed (async) = event/stream; solid (sync) = awaited request/reply; dotted (local) = file/IPC.
Timer, skip, retry

Default 30s; --autosave 0 = off. Ticks join an
in-flight save; unchanged state skips. Errors
go only to the ~/.crumb/run log; before
advances only on success, so the next tick
retries.
Source: src/session.ts
Merge in memory, no lock

Between steps 3 and 4, only before → after
changes are applied to the latest entry, plus
sync provenance and browser hints. No lock:
another process's write in that window is
lost.
Source: src/vault.ts
Key cached at startup

Key: CRUMB_KEY, else config.json's keyStore
(Keychain, Secret Service or ~/.crumb/key).
Cached at startup, so saves make no
key-store calls. Body is AES-256-GCM;
header is plaintext.
Source: src/crypto.ts
